- TOTAL revenue reached £15.8k in TW versus £3.5k in LW, a WoW change of +354.5%.
- TOTAL units came to 33,476 in TW against 1,259 in LW, a WoW change of +2,558.9%, while TOTAL orders rose from 101 in LW to 136 in TW, +34.7% WoW.
- SMALL FAIRY CAKE FRIDGE MAGNETS ranked 1 in TW with £6,467.60, a 41.0% share of TOTAL TW revenue.
- DOOR MAT RED SPOT ranked 2 in TW with £2,021.25 and a 12.8% share, ahead of BLACK AND WHITE PAISLEY FLOWER MUG at rank 3 with £1,946.33 and a 12.3% share.
- The top 3 products combined for 66.1% of TOTAL TW revenue.
- SMALL FAIRY CAKE FRIDGE MAGNETS added £6,467.60 of revenue WoW, the largest absolute WoW gain.
- DOOR MAT SPOTTY HOME SWEET HOME revenue grew 417.3% WoW, while WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER grew 17.6% WoW, equal to £284.37.
- BLACK AND WHITE PAISLEY FLOWER MUG led TW units at 19,165, and WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER led TW orders at 47.
